_comment: ProjectBW AutoPlug egg. Based on ImLunaUwU/PteroPlug v0.1.3.
name: AutoPlug Minecraft
author: ProjectBW
description: AutoPlug Minecraft egg for Pelican/Pterodactyl. AutoPlug configuration is generated during installation only and is never rewritten on server startup.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd /mnt/server
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt update
apt install -y curl jq wget sed
mkdir -p autoplug mods plugins
if [ ! -f AutoPlug-Client.jar ]; then
  wget -O AutoPlug-Client.jar https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Osiris-Team/AutoPlug-Releases/master/stable-builds/AutoPlug-Client.jar
fi
wget -O autoplug/general.yml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ImLunaUwU/PteroPlug/main/general.yml
wget -O autoplug/updater.yml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ImLunaUwU/PteroPlug/main/updater.yml

# IMPORTANT: substitutions happen during installation/reinstallation only.
# The egg has no config.files startup mappings, so normal starts never rewrite these files.
SERVER_KEY_ESCAPED=$(printf '%s' "$SERVER_KEY" | sed 's/[&/]/\\&/g')
SERVER_TYPE_ESCAPED=$(printf '%s' "$SERVER_TYPE" | sed 's/[&/]/\\&/g')
GAME_VERSION_ESCAPED=$(printf '%s' "$GAME_VERSION" | sed 's/[&/]/\\&/g')
JAVA_ARGS_ESCAPED=$(printf '%s' "$JAVA_ARGS" | sed 's/[&/]/\\&/g')

sed -i -e "s|^    key:.*$|    key: $SERVER_KEY_ESCAPED|" -e "s|^    start-command:.*$|    start-command: java -Xms128M -Xmx500M $JAVA_ARGS_ESCAPED -jar ./$SERVER_TYPE_ESCAPED.jar|" autoplug/general.yml
sed -i -e "s|^    software:.*$|    software: $SERVER_TYPE_ESCAPED|" -e "s|^    version:.*$|    version: $GAME_VERSION_ESCAPED|" autoplug/updater.yml

if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
  wget -O server.properties https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkervcp/eggs/master/minecraft/java/server.properties
fi
if [ -n "$SERVER_PORT" ] && [ -f server.properties ]; then
  sed -i -E "s/^server-port=.*/server-port=$SERVER_PORT/" server.properties || true
fi
echo 'AutoPlug installation complete. Config files will not be rewritten on startup.'

variables.name: AutoPlug Server Key
variables.description: Optional AutoPlug server key. Written to autoplug/general.yml during installation only.

variables.name: Game Version
variables.description: Minecraft version, for example 1.21.10. Written to autoplug/updater.yml during installation only.

variables.name: Java Launch Arguments
variables.description: Additional Java arguments used by AutoPlug.
